commands.name: $(window) Run SHRIMP electron
commands.command: distrobox enter arch-dev -- bash -c 'SHRIMP=/home/jordan/Documents/Code-Projects/shrimp; echo "[shrimp] Building frontend..."; ELECTRON=1 npm --prefix "$SHRIMP/frontend" run build || { echo "[shrimp] Build failed"; exit 1; }; echo "[shrimp] Starting backend..."; fuser -k 8000/tcp 2>/dev/null || true; (cd "$SHRIMP/backend" && .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --reload-dir . --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 >> "$SHRIMP/.ollama/backend.log" 2>&1) & BPID=$!; echo "[shrimp] Starting Electron..."; GTK_MODULES= DISPLAY=:0 npx --prefix "$SHRIMP" electron . --no-sandbox 2>/dev/null & EPID=$!; cleanup() { echo "[shrimp] Shutting down..."; kill $BPID $EPID 2>/dev/null; wait $BPID $EPID 2>/dev/null; }; trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM; echo "[shrimp] Running — Ctrl+C to stop both"; wait $EPID'
